description: This is a comprehensive unit test class for the BasicUserRoleManager component within the OrangeHRM project. The class tests various functionalities related to user roles, entity access permissions, system users, location permissions, home page and module default page retrieval, and other authorization-related features. The tests are performed on the 'BasicUserRoleManager' class and involve mock dependencies, fixture data loading, and validation of role-based access controls.

classes.name: BasicUserRoleManagerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the BasicUserRoleManager's functionality in role and permission management, user access, home page retrieval, and other authorization-related features within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup for each test, loading configuration fixtures, truncating and populating test data, and initializing the manager instance.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmployeeIdsExcludeIncludeRoles
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of accessible employee IDs with various role inclusion and exclusion filters.

methods.name: testAreEmployeesAccessibleAdmin
methods.description: Checks if admin users can access all or specific employee entities.

methods.name: testAreEmployeesAccessibleSupervisor
methods.description: Tests entity accessibility for supervisor users with subordinate hierarchies.

methods.name: testAreEmployeesAccessibleESS
methods.description: Verifies that ESS (Employee Self-Service) users do not have access to employee entities.

methods.name: testIsEmployeeAccessibleAdmin
methods.description: Checks if admin users can access specific employee entities by ID.

methods.name: testIsEmployeeAccessibleSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if supervisors can access specific subordinate employee entities.

methods.name: testIsEmployeeAccessibleESS
methods.description: Ensures ESS users cannot access employee entities.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleSystemUsersAdmin
methods.description: Verifies that admin users can access all system users.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleSystemUsersESSSupervisor
methods.description: Verifies that ESS and supervisor users cannot access all system users.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleOperationalCountriesESSSupervisor
methods.description: Verifies operational countries access for supervisor and ESS users.

methods.name: testGetUserRoles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of user roles in various user contexts including admin and supervisor.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissions
methods.description: Tests retrieval of screen permissions based on user roles.

methods.name: testFilterRoles
methods.description: Validates filtering of user roles based on inclusion/exclusion lists.

methods.name: testFilterRolesSupervisorForEmployee
methods.description: Tests role filtering logic when a supervisor filters subordinates' roles.

methods.name: testGetHomePage
methods.description: Retrieves the home page based on user roles and verifies prioritization.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of default page for a module based on user roles and priority.

methods.name: __convertRoleNamesToObjects
methods.description: Helper to convert role name strings into UserRole objects.

methods.name: compareUserRoles
methods.description: Asserts that expected role names match obtained UserRole objects.

methods.name: compareEmployees
methods.description: Validates that expected employees are present in the actual list by employee number.

methods.name: compareArrays
methods.description: Compares two arrays for equality in size and content.

methods.name: checkEmployees
methods.description: Checks that expected employee IDs are present in the actual result set.

methods.name: getEmployeeIds
methods.description: Returns a list of employee IDs from a list of Employee objects.

methods.name: getObjectIds

methods.name: testGetActionableStatesInvalidAction
methods.description: Verifies that invalid actions return an empty list of states.

methods.name: testGetActionableStatesUserRoleWithNoWorkflowAccess

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEss

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionForAdmin
